operations.reason: Make the entry-point validation contract explicit while preserving the existing owner-specific validators and inventory.

edits.replacement: At the CLI entry point, every user-facing argument in this inventory shall be validated before it is passed to any internal function. The entry point shall invoke the named command or value owner's existing validator for the applicable type, format, domain, conditional, path, and size rules; internal context and injected runtime state remain outside this boundary.

finding.body:
**Target:** R3/R5/T5; src/sennel.js:renderSharedHelp
**Issue:** The public `sennel flow <group> --help` and leaf `--help` requests are intercepted by `src/sennel.js` before `src/flow.js` or `dispatcher` runs. No-leaf `sennel flow <group>` instead uses `CommandDefinition.renderHelp`, while `sennel help flow <group>` uses `src/help.js`. The spec does not assign the existing `src/sennel.js` interception to the shared renderer, and its initialization may also create logger/config side effects.
**Required change:** Add `src/sennel.js`'s shared-help interception to the help-route contract, requiring it, `src/flow.js` no-leaf help, and `src/help.js` to use the same routed renderer while preserving locale and no-side-effect behavior.
**Why blocking:** Changing only the dispatcher, `flow.js`, or `help.js` will not make the public routes equivalent; tests can pass against an unreachable path while the actual CLI still emits different rows/options or performs help-time initialization.

finding.body:
**Target:** R6/T6; src/sennel.js pre-scan and src/lib/container.js
**Issue:** `src/sennel.js` pre-scans only the separate-token form `--agent-work-dir <path>`. The dispatcher accepts `--agent-work-dir=<path>`, but `initContainer` has already fixed `container.paths.agentWorkDir` and `logDir`, and command handlers use those paths rather than repairing the parsed input.
**Required change:** Specify that the pre-init `src/sennel.js` scan normalizes both spellings before `initContainer`, and require a real-CLI assertion of the resulting agent and log paths for configured and default cases.
**Why blocking:** Parser acceptance alone can pass while the equals form executes agents and writes logs under the configured/default directory, violating the required precedence and runtime-path contract.

finding.body:
**Target:** R1; src/lib/command-registry.js and src/help.js
**Improvement:** Name the marker carried from `FLOW_COMMANDS` through `CommandDefinition` into help metadata that gates the structured renderer, instead of relying on namespace names or section labels.
**Why non-blocking:** The spec already requires routed-only opt-in, and an implementation can add this provenance without changing the requested behavior.
finding.evidence: The immutable spec already requires routed-only structured projection and a shared renderer; explicitly naming the provenance marker would improve implementation clarity but is not needed to unblock the scoped work.

finding.body:
**Target:** R6/R8; tests/integration/flow/ctx-dispatch.test.js
**Improvement:** Update the existing guard assertions to cover `--expect-binding` or delegate them fully to the dynamic registry contract test.
**Why non-blocking:** The new exhaustive contract tests can provide the required five-guard coverage; this is maintenance of an older static test rather than an implementation gate.
finding.evidence: The immutable spec assigns exhaustive guard coverage to the dynamic registry contract and focused real-CLI coverage to E2E; extending the older static assertion is useful maintenance but does not block the specified contract.
